title: VisionTrace Mortgage Document Review — canonical, provider-neutral contracts (v1)
description: Contracts exchanged between the Mortgage Case Service (MCS) and a document-review provider (GeminiReviewProvider today, VisionTraceReviewProvider later). A verdict here is a DOCUMENT-REVIEW outcome. It is never a credit decision, never an authenticity certificate and never bank acceptance. Status: PROPOSED (TO BUILD) — none of these REST/MCP payloads exist in VisionTrace today except where the D document marks a field as mapped from an existing VisionTrace envelope.

CaseRef.description: The Mortgage Case Service case id (system of record for the case). VisionTrace never invents it.

ReviewCaseReference.description: Human/voice label (Crockford) — identifies, never authorises. Same shape as VisionTrace claim-case references.

ReviewRunReference.description: VisionTrace speakable reference: 'R-' + first five characters of the run id (server_tools.reference).

DocumentId.description: MCS logical document id. Versions of the same logical document share it.

PartyId.description: Party within the case, e.g. BRW-A (borrower), GRT-1 (guarantor), SLR-1 (seller).

FindingKey.description: Stable identity across re-reviews: CODE:subject[:period]. A re-review re-derives keys; equal key = same finding.

RequirementCode.description: Requirement-catalog code from the B matrix, optionally bound to a party, e.g. INC.PAYSLIP:BRW-A.

ReviewVerdict.description: Document-review verdict. Precedence when several apply: UNSUPPORTED > UNREADABLE > INVALID > NEEDS_REVIEW > VALID. VALID = conforms to every applicable rubric criterion WITH VERIFIED EVIDENCE; it is not authenticity and not bank acceptance.

CriterionOutcomeValue.description: Maps to the VisionTrace ledger: PASS→pass, FAIL→review (+severity), NEEDS_REVIEW→review, INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE→insufficient, NOT_APPLICABLE→not_applicable.

ReviewState.description: Who must act next. Same semantics as the demo's ReviewState (NEEDS_BANKER_REVIEW renamed BANKER_REVIEW_REQUIRED; adapter maps both).

Witness.description: How the value was proven to be printed at the cited location. Only text_layer_exact, ocr_token_match and vision_reread_confirmed count as VERIFIED.

Precision.description: VisionTrace field_locator precision: exact = word geometry; approximate = model box; page = whole page only.

FactStatus.description: absent = the document does not print it; illegible = printed but unreadable; ambiguous = several printed candidates; not_applicable = field does not apply to this document variant.

ReadinessStatus.description: DOCUMENTARY readiness for the reviewed scope only. Never 'approved'.

PolicyParameterStatus.description: Where a threshold/window comes from. PENDING_BANK_POLICY values must not drive a FAIL on their own; see rubric verdict policies.

provider_version.description: VisionTrace git SHA / image tag, or demo prompt version.

policy_store_version.description: Revision of the bank policy-parameter store used.

models.description: purpose → model id (e.g. read, ocr, judge, semantic).

input_hash.description: sha256 over canonical request (document hashes + context + policy) — equal input_hash + equal versions ⇒ deterministic stages must reproduce.

source_ref.description: G ledger source id, e.g. S05.

page.description: 1-based page in the ORIGINAL file (VisionTrace stores 0-based page_index; adapter adds 1).

quote.description: Exact printed characters the value was read from (label included when the reader quoted it).

bbox.description: [x0,y0,x1,y1] normalised 0..1, origin top-left, in the page's DISPLAYED frame (rotation applied) — the VisionTrace field_locator convention.

bbox_pdf_points.description: Optional: same box in unrotated PDF points (demo convention).

occurrences_on_page.description: How many times the same characters are printed on the page (locality: a value printed twice must be anchored to the occurrence its quote names).

snippet_url.description: Short-lived signed URL of the evidence snip (TO BUILD: service endpoint over artifacts.read_artifact).

normalized.description: Typed value after deterministic normalisation (money → {amount,currency}; month → YYYY-MM; date → YYYY-MM-DD; national_id → 9 digits).

candidates.description: Only when status=ambiguous: every printed candidate, none chosen.

self_reported_confidence.description: Model's own number. INFORMATIONAL ONLY — never a gate.

verified.description: true iff at least one evidence item has witness ∈ {text_layer_exact, ocr_token_match, vision_reread_confirmed}.

downgraded_reason.description: Why code changed the judge's outcome (missing citation, unverified field, conflict with code).

text_layer.description: unreliable = text layer exists but does not decode to readable Hebrew (no ToUnicode / garbled) — treated as none.

duplicate_of.description: document_id@version with the SAME sha256 already in this case.

demo_marked.description: The page prints the synthetic-corpus marker (VisionTrace DEMO_MARK 'מסמך דמו').

pdf_metadata_signals.description: Weak tamper signals, e.g. incremental_update_after_signature, producer_image_editor. Never decisive.

signals.description: Printed title/keywords that support the type (quotes).

claimed_by_filename.description: Type/month the FILE NAME claims (display only, never decisive).

bundle.description: One file carries several documents (e.g. three payslips in one PDF).

authenticity.description: VisionTrace does not certify authenticity. DIGITAL_SIGNATURE_VALID only when a cryptographic signature was validated against a trusted chain.

bank_acceptance.description: Owned by the bank; mirrored in MCS from bank systems, never set by a provider.

line_items.description: Tables as read (payslip earnings/deductions, statement transactions) — every row with its evidence.

category.description: Semantic category (e.g. base_salary, overtime, bonus, benefit_in_kind, income_tax, salary_deposit, loan_repayment) — judge/semantic output, never used for arithmetic.

security_flags.description: Untrusted instruction text found in the document (quoted, never followed).

CrossDocumentComparison.description: Mirrors VisionTrace crop_flow/comparison.py: every compared value shown on its own document with its evidence, plus the method and the arithmetic.

source.description: document_id, or 'mcs:declared' for application data supplied by MCS (declared ≠ evidence).

evidentiary_status.description: A customer explanation is context. It never closes a finding by itself.

assessment_he.description: Semantic stage note: whether submitted evidence supports, contradicts or is silent on the statement.

message_customer_he.description: Customer-safe: no ID numbers, no other party's data, no credit wording, no 'approved/accepted'. Null for banker-only findings.

requested_items.description: Machine codes a supplement link may ask for, e.g. payslip:BRW-A:2026-09 (VisionTrace missing_items convention extended with the party).

not_reproduced_by_run.description: Set when a BANKER_REVIEW_REQUIRED finding raised by a judge/hybrid criterion (or resolvable only by NEW_EVIDENCE) is absent from a later run. The finding stays OPEN until a banker records confirm_resolution — the system never closes a banker finding on model output alone.

scope.description: Only the requirement codes this provider reviewed. Everything else is NOT_EVALUATED, never implied complete.

basis.description: What the application field actually asked. Comparison only like-for-like.

national_id.description: Sent only over the service channel; never echoed in customer-facing text.

required_periods.description: MCS/bank supplies them when known; otherwise the provider derives them from policy and states the derivation.

evaluate.description: false = listed for context only (e.g. appraisal sent directly by the appraiser); provider must report it NOT_EVALUATED.

bank_status.description: Opaque mirror of the bank's own status for the item (awaiting_documents, accepted_by_bank …). Read-only context.

submitted_to_bank_at.description: Anchor of the public 45-day re-send rule (S05).

as_of.description: Review date (the demo's SIMULATION_DATE). Every period/recency rule computes from it.

workflow_version.description: Pin a published version; null = current published.

policy_overrides.description: Only values the bank has confirmed (status CONFIRMED_BANK_POLICY).

superseded_documents.description: Earlier versions kept for audit, excluded from computation.

channel.description: touch_upload = the customer uploads in Tefahot Touch and MCS forwards (preferred); intake_link = VisionTrace one-time link (existing supplement mechanism).

mode.description: add = new logical documents; replace = new version of an existing logical document (each DocumentRef.replaces set). The re-review always runs over the WHOLE current evidence set.

BankerDecision.description: Generalises VisionTrace ClaimDecision. Bound to the review the banker SAW; a newer run makes it stale (409).

LifecycleEvent.description: Webhook + audit event. Bounded: never document bytes, extracted text, ID numbers, salaries or model output. Signed like the existing VisionTrace webhook: X-VisionTrace-Timestamp + X-VisionTrace-Signature: sha256=HMAC(secret, ts + '.' + body).
